IFA Channel Development Manager | Financial Products
IFA Channel Development Manager | Financial Products
Relationship Manager
description:
**Company Description** 
 GCL Dreams is part of GCL, one of India’s leading diversified financial services groups, promoted by a family with decades of experience in financial markets. As a member of major exchanges such as NSE, BSE, MCX, and NCDEX, GCL offers robust online and offline platforms for investing, hedging, and trading. The organization focuses on delivering expert financial services tailored to clients’ present and future needs. GCL has grown from an entrepreneurial start\-up to a market leader by adapting to changing market conditions while maintaining a strong focus on its core financial services domain.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Relationship Manager is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Ahmedabad. This role is responsible for building, managing, and strengthening relationships with existing and prospective clients across GCL Dreams’ financial products and services. Day\-to\-day activities include understanding client goals, recommending suitable investment and trading solutions, addressing queries, and ensuring timely resolution of service issues. The Relationship Manager will regularly follow up with clients, assist with account opening and documentation, and coordinate with internal teams to deliver a seamless client experience. The role also involves identifying new business opportunities, meeting defined sales and retention targets, and maintaining accurate records of client interactions and portfolios.
   

**Qualifications**
  

* Strong client relationship management skills, including ability to build trust, understand client needs, and provide tailored financial solutions.
* Solid communication and interpersonal skills to explain financial products clearly and handle client queries professionally.
* Basic to intermediate knowledge of capital markets, trading, and investment products; prior experience in financial services or brokerage is an advantage.
* Proficiency in using CRM tools, MS Office, and online trading or investment platforms.
* Ability to work towards sales and retention targets, with good negotiation and problem\-solving skills.
* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Commerce, Business Administration, Economics, or a related field; relevant certifications (e.g., NISM) are beneficial.
* High level of integrity, attention to detail, and a customer\-centric mindset.
* Comfort working in an on\-site environment in Ahmedabad and collaborating with cross\-functional teams.

title: Key Account Manager
description:
**Job Summary**
 We are seeking a highly motivated and result\-driven Key Account Manager to manage and expand our solar product sales in Ahmedabad. The candidate will be responsible for handling key accounts and driving revenue through the sale of complete solar solutions, including solar panels, inverters, wires, and other related components. The role involves working with both B2B and B2C customers, ensuring strong client relationships and consistent business growth.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Drive sales of solar kits and complete solar solutions across B2B and B2C segments
* Manage and maintain relationships with key clients, dealers, and distributors
* Identify new business opportunities and generate leads
* Achieve assigned sales targets and contribute to overall business growth
* Provide customers with appropriate product recommendations based on their requirements
* Coordinate with internal teams for order processing, installation, and after\-sales support
* Keep updated with market trends, competitor activities, and product knowledge


**Qualifications \& Experience**
* 1–2 years of experience in the solar industry (mandatory)
* Prior experience in sales of solar kits or related products is required
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or related field (preferred)


**Skills \& Competencies**
* Strong communication, presentation, and negotiation skills
* Ability to manage both corporate (B2B) and retail (B2C) customers
* Target\-oriented with a proactive approach
* Good problem\-solving and customer relationship management skills


**Other Requirements**
* Willingness to travel locally for client meetings
* Self\-motivated and able to work independently

title: Live Chat Team Leader/Manager – for Billing & Technical Queries - UK Telcoms Provider Location: Onsite, Pune India (UK Hours)
description:
My Client, a leading Telecoms provider to 40,000 UK small businesses has a rare opportunity for an experienced individual to
 **build and lead their Live Chat Support team in Pune, India.** 




  





 Reporting to the Head of Operations (Ex Amazon leader) who is based in their Cape Town office, the Team Leader will be responsible for starting up and growing a new Live Chat team in India to handle tech support and some billing customer queries. The individual must be able to hire, manage and motivate a high performance chat team providing exceptional support, transitioning smoothly from their current Cape Town Live Chat operations.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  





**Master the company Product Knowledge and technical troubleshooting.** 




  




* Onboard, coach, lead and motivate a team of Chat Support Agents providing billing and tech support.
* Manage day\-to\-day performance, attendance, quality and customer satisfaction during UK business hours 9am to 6pm BST.
* Provide guidance and escalation support for complex billing and technical issues.
* Ensure customer queries are handled efficiently and in line with company processes and SLAs.
* Conduct regular 1\-to\-1's, performance reviews and coaching sessions.
* Identify training and development needs and support Agent progression and growth.
* Work closely with technical, billing and other internal teams to resolve customer issues.
* Monitor team KPIs and implement improvements where required.
* Promote a positive, accountable and customer\-focused team culture.Can we add something relating to the hours or shifts etc?



  





**Key Requirements:** 




  




* Must have proven experience leading an International Chat Support team.
* 2–5 years’ experience managing in a fast\-paced, Tech Support Customer Service environment.
* Proven experience leading, coaching and developing a team of excellent agents.
* Excellent verbal and written English communication skills.
* Strong motivational, coaching and performance management skills.
* Experience supporting customers with billing and/or technical queries.
* Comfortable working with chat\-based support and cutting edge, AI\-based solutions like FIN.ai.
* Strong problem\-solving, analytical and decision\-making abilities.
* Customer\-focused, meticulous and results oriented.
* Experience within VoIP, Telecoms or Software would be helpful.



  





*Due to high application volumes, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted \- but we genuinely review, appreciate and value every application and wish you the very best in your search. Please follow us for future roles.*
